description: Synthetic comments written for this project (not YouTube data) for a fictional, brand-sponsored long-term review of a fictional folding e-bike. Built to benchmark topic discovery and assignment offline: gold taxonomy, one gold topic disposition per non-spam comment and the sentiment toward its primary topic. Overall classification labels are oracle inputs for topic analysis (sampling and aggregation), not a classifier benchmark. Independent of m2-synthetic, m2-heldout-v1, guideline and question examples and earlier topic tests. Test fixtures only.

taxonomy.name: Riding range
taxonomy.definition: How far the bike travels on one charge, including range estimates and how quickly the battery drains.

taxonomy.name: Motor assist
taxonomy.definition: How the electric assist feels and performs, including power on hills, assist levels, pickup and motor sound.

taxonomy.name: Folding and carrying
taxonomy.definition: The folding mechanism and latches, the folded size, and carrying or storing the folded bike.

taxonomy.name: Ride comfort
taxonomy.definition: How comfortable the bike is to ride, including saddle, suspension, tyres, handlebars and fit.

taxonomy.name: Charging and battery removal
taxonomy.definition: The charger, charging time, the charging port and removing the battery to charge it.

taxonomy.name: Price and value
taxonomy.definition: What the bike and its accessories cost and whether that is worth the money.

taxonomy.name: Brakes and stopping
taxonomy.definition: How the bike brakes and stops, including brake feel, brake noise, levers and stopping distance.

taxonomy.name: Companion app
taxonomy.definition: The phone app used to pair with the bike, update firmware, change settings or lock the motor.
